batting.dismissal: c Iqbal Abdulla b YK Pathan

batting.dismissal: c R Bhatia b JD Unadkat

batting.name: RA Jadeja
batting.dismissal: c YK Pathan b R Bhatia

batting.name: EJG Morgan
batting.dismissal: run out (PA Patel, R Vinay Kumar)

batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c DPMD Jayawardene b RV Gomez

batting.name: MK Tiwary
batting.dismissal: c BB McCullum b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: YK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c DPMD Jayawardene b R Vinay Kumar

balls.text: finally gets it right, Hodge can only dig it out into the leg side past midwicket for a single
Punishment! Lee can't get the yorker, instead it's another pitched up delivery outside of fand Hodge isn't going to spare it, makes room and carts it over the covers for four more
The length ball again and Hodge is enjoying himself, in the slot on middle, he makes a bit of room and swings it away, another monstrous strike into the stands
pitched up and Hodge cashes in, moves away and drives him over extra cover for a one bounce four, landed just inside the ropes
Hodge sends that into the stands, short ball on middle and he is into position early and pulls it ferociously into the crowd, plenty of venom in that shot
back of a length on middle, turned down towards fine leg for a single

run-out, pitched up and Hodge strikes it clean over the bowler's head but there is protection, long-off runs across, picks it up and returns a good throw to the non-striker's end as Mahela runs back for the second, Kallis collects and takes down the stumps to find him short despite the dive. It seemed as though it was his forearm that made contact with the stumps but he had the ball in his hand, so that's fine.
low full toss again and Hodge tries to swing that into the leg side, can't connect
nicely bowled, aiming for the yorker, Mahela digs it out into the leg side for a single
low full toss outside off, the fielder at deep cover fumbles, Abdulla it is, and they have plenty of time to run back for the second
moved well across and Kallis chased him, tried to paddle it fine, missed
raises his fifty with a slice over point, he's led Kochi's recovery after those two early losses, full delivery and he made Kallis pay
full and way too wide, easy one for the umpire

brilliant fielding by Morgan in the deep, pitched up outside off, made room and crunched it through the off side past extra cover, Morgan ran several paces to his right, dived and hauled it back in to keep them down to just two
called a no-ball since it was the second bouncer of the over, went for the upper cut again did Hodge and missed
short outside off, tries to upper cut that but it's too quick and beats the bat

low full toss outside off, Mahela moved away and steered it past Gambhir, was it dropped? Seemed like it, Gambhir dived full length to his right but wasn't able to clasp it, just a single in the end as he palmed it off into the deep, a tough chance again
short ball and he's struck on the ribs, Mahela calls for the single and Hodge responds, obstructing Lee's vision by running in front of the stumps and making it comfortably
driven back firmly but Lee gets a hand to it, rolls down in front of long-off and by the time the fielder gets to it, they've come back for the second
poor ball, juicy delivery on the pads and Hodge doesn't waste it, glancing it down to the fine leg boundary
driven wide of midwicket for a single to keep strike
picked it up well but couldn't find the gap, loopy full toss on middle, swung away but Eoin Morgan covers good ground to keep them to one
full outside off, makes room and slices it over point for a couple more
slower one bowled full on the off, pushed towards wide long-on for one more
bowled full on middle, driven wide of long-on for a single
picked it up beautifully, Bhatia slipped in the slower one on middle, Mahela walked across, bent low and swept it hard over the long-leg boundary for a six
slow through the air, Mahela waits for it and bunts it past midwicket for a single
slightly short on middle, they're saving the big hits for a short while later, a single to square leg
short on middle, pulled away towards deep square leg for a single
short on leg side, swivels and turns it towards short fine leg, no run there
on middle and leg, worked away into the leg side for a single
short of a good length on middle, punched down the ground to long-on for a single
on middle and leg, gets across and drives it wide of midwicket for a single

not the slower one, bowled at normal pace, came onto Jadeja a little quicker, he had shaped up for the slog-sweep and couldn't connect well, got a top edge and Yusuf made no mistake standing at square leg
straying on the pads, clamly tucked away past square leg into the deep for a single
the back of the hand slower one, knocked wide of midwicket for a quick single
good length on the off, a hint of movement away, pushed towards long-off for a single
floating it on middle and off, drops it in front of cover, thinks of a single but there isn't one
chopped in the direction of point off the back foot
short of a good length outside off, waits for it to turn in, cuts it behind point for a single
drops it short on middle, rocks back to pull it towards deep midwicket, just the single
bowling from round the wicket, angles it towards middle and leg, gets forward and drops it into the leg side
gets across and nudges it behind short fine for a quick single
turning down after landing on middle, called a wide
beaten, holds its line this time, just a fraction short of a good length, pokes at it, misses
back of a length outside off, tries to use the pace to play it past the keeper but is surprised by the exra bounce, misses
finds the gap this time, drops it short once again and he rocks back to pull it behind square to beat the man in the deep to the ropes
short and he rocks back to pull it firmly past deep midwicket for a couple of runs
good length on the off, gets forward and defends it towards point
short of a good length on middle, knocked down into the leg side for a single
short and flat on middle, jabs it wide of long-on for a single

Klinger holes out, Abdulla's right at the edge of the ropes at deep midwicket, it's tossed up and Klinger accepted the invitation, came down the track and launch it high and handsome but couldn't clear the ropes as Abdulla judged it to perfection and kept his balance to take it inches inside the boundary
waits for it to turn in and nudges it wide of square leg for a single
Klinger comes down and whips that towards deep square leg for a single to raise the 50-stand
gets forward and chips it towards long-on for a single
that's his standout shot, floating it full on the off stump and Mahela just lofts it cleanly over extra cover to pick up a one bounce four, perfectly in the gap
slower one bowled on a good length, chipped in front of long-on for one more
a bit more pace on that one and a hint of away movement, closed the face a little too early did Klinger, got a leading edge that landed wide of point
short and slow again, one of those back of the hand dibbly dobblies, cut away in the direction of deep point for a single
slower one bowled short outside off, cuts it wide of point for a quick single
slower one bowled short on middle, jabs it in front of midwicket for a single
slightly short outside off, dabs it towards short third man
fires it flat on middle,turns it in front of square leg for a single
gets across and works it away behind square gently, enough time to race back for the second
pushed down the ground past the diving Abdulla for a single
pitched up on middle and leg, worked away towards midwicket
flighted outside off, Klinger finds the gap, makes a bit of room and drives it uppishly between long-off and deep cover for a boundary
slightly short on the off, punched towards deep cover for a single
follows that up with a tap to clinch a single, time for the Time Out, Kochi have had a few good overs
a chip but a dangerous one, good length ball, Mahela got forward and just lofted it over the in-field but clearly didn't get hold, Ladda tried his best with the dive from cover but couldn't reach it
short of a good length on the off, defended into the off side off the back foot

appeal for run-out, dropped into the off side, Klinger calls initially and then decides to send back Mahela, Kallis collects and aims accurately to throw down the stumps at the non-striker's end but Mahela's slide has saved him. They sneak a single thanks to the ricochet
edged and four, landed on a length and Klinger was looking to smack it through the line over the bowler's head, instead he got an outside edge to the third-man boundary
slower one on middle and off, clips it behind square for a single
slightly short on the off, turning away just a hint, defended towards point from the crease
goodish length on the off, gets forward and drops it into the leg side towards midwicket for one more
lands full on the off, drilled down the ground towards long-on for a single
flighted outside off, eased towards deep cover for a single
flicked off the front foot past midwicket for a well-run couple
Mahela takes full toll, comes down the track to that pitched up delivery and deposits it over extra cover into the crowd, an inside-out drive, that brings up 1000 runs for him in the IPL
starts with a no-ball, pushed full, driven down to long-on for a single
a hint of movement away after pitching, Klinger calmly runs it down to third man for a single
slightly short on the off, Klinger gets back and pushes it past the bowler into the leg side
accurate stuff, on and around off stump, gets on the back foot does Klinger and defends it into the off side
slightly short on middle, works it away past square leg for one more
lands on a good length outside off, holds its line and Mahela has a poke at it, doesn't make contact
short of a good length on middle, turned off the back foot behind square for a single
goodish length outside off, angling away again, Mahela leaves it alone
angling away from the right hander, Mahela leaves it be
short on the off again, knocks it down into the off side for a single
Klinger's fortunate here, short and he goes for the pull, targeting square leg, but it rises more than he expects, gets a top edge over the keeper and to the boundary

Rajat Bhatia holds his nerve to take a good catch, Unadkat dropped short and Parthiv appeared to have made his mind up. He's thrown his wicket away here, came down the track and again tried to swing it over midwicket, miscued it and Bhatia ran back a few paces and clasped it close to his chest on the third attempt
short of a good length on the off, gets back and knocks it towards point
keeps it flat, Klinger comes down the track to that straight ball and defends it into the leg side
made a bit of room and Abdulla chased him, pushed it full on the pads and he drove it towards deep midwicket for one more
flighted on middle, Klinger drives it wristily past midwicket for a single
slightly short on the off, drops it wide of point for a single
shortish, waits for it to turn in slightly, punched towards extra cover
tossed up, lands full on middle and off, Parthiv steps out of the crease and smacks him over mid-off, a nice welcome
shortish on the off, runs it down towards third man to keep strike
he now wants to send it into the streets, came down the track to that shortish delivery and had a swoosh, missed
pacy this time, banged it short outside off, Parthiv thinks of playing at it initially and then decides to withdraw but it just went past the outside edge, had him in a bit of trouble
Parthiv's looking really good, angling in towards the pads and Parthiv moves across to just chip it over midwicket for a boundary, lovely timing once again
edged and flies away towards third man, good length outside off and he tries to smash it through the line, drops short of the fielder, just the single
pitched up and it's driven firmly along the ground towards mid-off, well struck but couldn't beat the fielder
short of a good length on the off, taps it into the off side from the crease
fires it on leg stump, gets back and knocks it down into the leg side
angling it towards middle and leg, gets across and works it past square leg for a single
ooh, gets an inside edge does Parthiv, a bit of width again and he tries to force it through the off side, gets it just wide of the leg stump to sneak a single
short and he latches onto it, beautifully timed, rocks on the back foot and crunches it past a diving point for four more
stroked away, pitched on a length outside off and he chases it, square-driving it powerfully through point for a boundary
shortish on middle, a little more pacy, fends it down into the leg side
short of a good length, knocks it away past point towards third man for a single
tame dismissal, short and wide and McCullum slashes at it, there isn't much pace in Unadkat so it doesn't fly away, lands safely in the palms of Jacques Kallis at slip

dropped, very difficult chance, Klinger didn't pick the slower one, was fullish on middle and he was targeting square leg, got a leading edge towards mid-on where Gambhir, running back, couldn't latch on despite the dive. Extremely difficult, they pick three in the meantime
angling it towards middle and off, McCullum gets across and drops it into the leg side for a quick single
down the leg side and called a wide, landed outside leg and moved down further
short of a good length on middle and leg, Klinger fends it away into the leg side for a single
maiden to start with, pitched up this time and he drives it elegantly but straight towards cover, encouraging start for Kolkata

beaten again, as good as the first one, held it back slightly and McCullum was committed on the front foot, tried to push through the line but was beaten by the away movement that just went past the outside edge
bowled on a good length on middle and off, gets forward and defends it solidly back towards the bowler
some swing this time, moving away, landed on middle and off, McCullum gets forward and opens the face slightly to steer it to Tiwary at point
nice movement for Lee, fullish outside off and moving away, McCullum opts to leave it alone
beauty! Lovely stuff, landed on the off stump and nipped away just at the right time to beat the outside edge as McCullum played forward
bowled'im, Kochi finish on a high as RP sends back Boucher who swings wildly but finds his off stump pegged back
pitched up on middle, played down to long-on for a single

pitched up to Lee, he drives it wide of long-off for a couple of runs, there's an appeal for a run-out but the throw was a wide one. Parthiv dived to take off the bails and it was enough to find Lee short, if only marginally. It is a run-out.
full and it's sliced wide of cover for just a single, the crowd can't stop cheering now since the result is more or less known
shot but only a couple as Hodge dives to his left to save two runs, pulled hard but he covered good ground in the deep
length ball outside off, dragged wide of midwicket, just the couple
dot ball, yorker length outside off and he can't squeeze it out, misses and Vinay completes an excellent over
Yusuf goes and it lookes beyond them now, full outside off and it's smashed hard but straight to Mahela who is positioned perfectly at extra cover, just inside the circle

run-out, another good delivery from Vinay, low full toss that Morgan couldn't do much against, gets to the keeper as he misses it on the swing and Yusuf has already run down the pitch to take strike next ball, by the time Morgan realises that it's too late and he sacrifices his wicket as Parthiv returns the ball to the bowler
appeal for a catch, slower one bowled full, reached for it and it appeared it was a bump ball, actually it was one. Landed just short of Jadeja at point. Just the single, was almost in the blockhole
Yusuf keeps the Kolkata hopes alive, full outside off and it's drilled hard past extra cover to the boundary
pitched up outside off, reaches for it and plays it down to long-on, just the single
beautifully placed from Yusuf, wide and full and he just sliced it past point to beat third man and deep point, executed perfectly
full toss again but it's a safe one, punched towards deep cover for just a single, what a lovely little over this from the home boy
another one, slower delivery this time and he swings at that one a little too early, misses
doesn't work for Morgan, had shaped up for the paddle, Prasanth bowled a full toss outside off and the batsman couldn't quite execute what he had planned, a valuable dot ball for the hosts
long-off is wider than usual and Yusuf finds him but on the bounce, length ball and he struck it hard, but just the single in the end
some reverse on that one, played down the ground to long-on for a single

just the single, a length delivery and he drags it wide of long-on into the deep but just the single as the fielder returns a good throw, an expensive over but still plenty of ground to cover for Kolkata
aiming for the yorker, almost gets it right, Yusuf stretches and runs it down to third man for a single
another full toss but a low one this time, played hard towards long-off for a single
full toss, poor delivery from the local boy, swung away into that gap behind midwicket for a one-bounce four
he connects this time, that's what he was aiming at and Sreesanth's mother is clearly worried in the stands. Pitched up and it was launched miles into the stands over long-on
Morgan's feeling the heat, that was a length ball he would have fancied dispatching but he couldn't connect
full toss and he almost drags it on, tries to smash it past midwicket, gets an inside edge onto his pads, just the single
pitched up outside off, driven wristily towards deep cover for just the single
full and wide and Yusuf is made to reach for it, tries to squeeze it past point, can't get his bat to it, Kolkata are under pressure
full toss on the off, smacked straight to mid-off, just the single in the end and it's a half-century, a well-played one at that
on the bounce, powerfully struck, it landed on a length and in the slot for Yusuf who'll regret not getting it wide of the fielder
short of a good length outside off, slices it over point for a couple of runs
the end of an excellent spell, pitched up and  Morgan can only manage to squeeze it back to the bowler
slower one, driven down towards long-off for a single, Gomez is doing well
short ball outside leg stump, tries to pull it hard behind square, not called a wide, Parthiv fumbles, the pressure builds
chips that one wide of long-on to give Yusuf the strike
slower one bowled full on middle, pushed back to the bowler
A slower one bowled full on the off, drilled down the ground to long-off for a single
Tiwary has succumed, short ball on the off and he went for the pull, came off the bottom of the bat and McCullum at midwicket took it easily
the slower one banged in short, bunts it into the leg side past midwicket for a single, a swat actually but not a very forceful one
gets it right this time, delicately done, it was the slower one from Vinay, waited for it to cut in, late-cut it just wide of a diving Parthiv to the third-man boundary
charges down the track to hammer that one over point again, the width was there this time and he'll consider that a wasted opportunity
short but not as wide as the previous one, a touch too close to cut, slashes again but misses
short and wide, they've bowled too many of those this innings, slashed away hard over point and in the gap for four more, a freebie as far as Morgan is concerned
clipped past midwicket for a single to keep strike, we are in for a close one here
low full toss and Morgan chips that wide of long-off for a couple of runs
a slower one bowled full on leg stump, defended back to the bowler
goodish length outside off, drops it between cover and point for a single
pretends to make room but shuffles back in again, it's a straight delivery that is worked to midwicket
pitched on a good length, punched on the bounce to extra cover
gets it on a good length this time, pushed back firmly past the bowler but mid-off is up
full on middle and leg, flicked away wide of deep square leg, Gomez picks it up and returns a not-so-strong throw on the bounce to Parthiv, Morgan made it back in time
Morgan's doing well here, low full toss on leg stump, clipped wide of fine leg to run back for the second

slashes hard, short and wide, RP is erring in length here, a poor start to the second spell, Morgan bends and whacks that over the third-man boundary, Vinay dived valiantly to his left but had no chance
deflects off the pads to the wicketkeeper who fumbles, down the leg side and he couldn't take advantage of it
a pressure-relieving boundary that, short and Morgan shapes to pull it hard over square leg, fine leg had no chance
starts with a really wide ball down the leg side
slower one bowled short on middle and leg, dropped into the leg side
the legcutter again, not unlike what Rajat Bhatia bowled in the first innings, pushed towards cover
nope, a simple short of a good length delivery outside off, defended comfortably towards point

gone first ball! The tide is turning, good length and Gambhir stepped away to play his favourite shot first ball, made room to clear extra cover but couldn't get the elevation he needed, played it straight into the hands of Mahela, Gomez is on a hat-trick
bowled'im! Was the slower legcutter, Kallis drove at that inside the line, tried to play it past extra cover, it cut away to beat the bat and peg back the off stump, a timely breakthrough for Kochi
short of a good length on middle, dropped into the leg side in front of the bowler
cracked along the ground towards deep cover for one more
went on with the arm, punched into the leg side ;past the bowler but Jadeja covers good ground to prevent the single
fullish outside off with a hint of turn away, sliced towards point
turned into the leg side for one more
pushed down the ground to long-off for a single
Kallis threads that between deep cover and long-off, was tossed up, pitched up and he drove that on bent knee powerfully through the off side, Kochi need a wicket quickly
the slower one on middle and leg, turned past short fine for a single
slower one bowled slightly short, dabs it in front of cover, thinks of a single but it just isn't there
good length on middle and off, defended towards cover
chipped towards long-off, safe shot as the field is spread out, just the single
streaky, Morgan tried to cream that through the covers, appeared as though he got an inside edge that scraped Parthiv's gloves on its way to the fine-leg boundary, can't quite call it a drop
length delivery on middle, driven hard back down the pitch, just the single as Gomez fails to stop it on his follow through
short of a good length on middle, turned in the direction of square leg for a single to keep strike
on the pads from Prasanth this time, flicked past square leg for a couple more

excellent fielding in the deep to a gorgeous shot, landed on a length and he lofted it Tendulkar style, but wide of long-off, Gomez ran yards to his left, dived and hauled it back in to keep them to just two though one would think the shot deserved more
driven back to the bowler and Prasanth fields it diving to his right, he's done well so far

appeal for caught-behind, pushed it fuller outside off, Kallis walked across to drive it through the leg side, there was a deflection and it and the keeper clasped it, replays show it went off the back leg, but we need to have another look. We haven't seen a replay yet but indications were that it went off the back leg and there wasn't any contact with the bat
short of a good length on middle, defended back to the bowler has plenty of encouragement from the crowd
punched down the ground towards long-on to raise the 50-stand, Kolkata are on track here

did not go where he intended it to go, short on middle and leg, tried to hook it past square leg, got a top edge and towards the fine-leg boundary, he'll take it, a bit of a relief from the spate of dot balls in the last couple of overs
Morgan clips that elegantly towards fine leg on the bounce, was on the pads, would have liked to get it finer
keeps a little low, good couple of overs now, Morgan gets his bat down in time to defend it to point
back of a length on middle, Morgan moves back and drops it in front of point
short of a good length, gets forward and plays it behind point for a single
tries to force that hard through extra cover even though the shot wasn't quite on, got a thick inside edge past midwicket for a single, a tidy start from Parameswaran
moving away from a short of a good length, eased it wide of cover for a single
slightly short on middle and off, gets forward and drops it in front of cover, big cheers from the home crowd
swinging away and aiming full, Morgan came forward to turn that past midwicket but converted it into a yorker, got a thick edge, along the ground, to slip
just short of a good length, Morgan gets forward and pushes it towards extra cover
lands on middle and leg, clipped past square leg for a single
angling it on middle, gets across and drives it wide of mid-on for a single to keep strike
shortish on the off, runs it down to third man for a single
slightly short on middle, gets across to turn it behind square for a single
short of a good length on middle, nipping in, Morgan tries to whip it square, struck high on the pads, they manage to sneak a run
short and wide, slashes hard, flies off the outside edge and lands on the bounce to third man
starts with a meaty delivery on middle and leg, Kallis flicks it past midwicket into the vast open space in the deep, two more
slower one bowled short on the off, punched towards mid-on for a quick single
Kallis moves across to fetch it from outside off to work it past short fine leg for a couple of runs
on a length on middle, turns it wide of mid-on for a quick single

that didn't miss the stumps by much, short, he swivelled and tried to pull it square, it struck his thighs and dropped just wide of the stumps, only a leg-bye in the end but it could have cost him his wicket
a touch fuller, Kallis gets to the pitch and pushes it firmly to cover
short of a good length on middle and off, Kallis gets back and drops it in front of the bowler, thinks of a single but wisely decides against it
uppish but in the gap again, short and he slashes at it really hard, beats the diving point and third man, fiercely struck
accurate this time, targeting middle and off, there is a bit of movement around as well  Morgan gets on the back foot and defends it into the leg side
swinging in, good length on middle and leg, turned past square leg for a single
poor stuff from RP, plenty of width and too short, Kallis can free his arms and flay it through point and cover for four more
short and he is into position early, rocks back and pulls it away over square leg, positive start from Kolkata to the chase
back of a length on middle, rocks back and taps it towards point
full and wide and he shapes up to drive that through the covers but doesn't make contact

appeal for lbw, was it missing leg? Some swing there for Sreesanth, landed on middle and leg and moving in, Morgan tried to hit that across the line, got a thin inside edge onto the pads, that's what saved him
a bit of extra bounce there, good length but rose up more than Kallis anticipated, played it well in the end, dropped his hands and got it wide of point for a single
down the leg side this time and it's called a wide
cannoned over the covers, good length on the off, Kallis made room and hammered that over the fielder, Klinger was the man there but couldn't reach it
kept low after landing short on middle, pushed it towards midwicket, Morgan called for the single and Kallis sent him back
a hint of swing there, moved away, pitched on the off and Kallis tried to drive him hard through cover, got a thick inside edge
short and wide, Morgam makes room and smashes it over the covers for a boundary, a gift ball that after a good start to the over
back of a length outside off, nips away and he lets it go
straying on the pads and Morgan cashes in, shuffles just a hint and helps it on its way past the diving Parthiv
beaten, lovely delivery, landed around the off stump and nipped away just enough to evade the bat, Morgan was playing forward to it but was beaten in the end
short of a good length on middle, worked away off the back foot behind square leg for a single
pitched up on the off stump, Kallis gets forward and drives it to extra cover
